verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same broken structure. The blue circle that framed the suitcase has become a cut-off blob at the bottom edge, with the Meridian logo dropped onto it beside the sunglasses, so the brand mark loses its top-left anchor. The CTA is also tiny and weak in both. A is worse because of a large dead gap between the headline and the subhead, a smaller suitcase that leaves empty bands, and a wide gap below the CTA. B keeps the headline and subhead together and gives the suitcase a confident size. However, its logo hangs off the circle almost to the right edge, and its CTA is still badly undersized next to the huge suitcase.
